title: Stop feeding the rehearsed wound
summary: Release becomes possible when return matters more than replay. Do not keep feeding the sentence that keeps the wound alive.
takeaway: Do not keep feeding the sentence that keeps the wound alive.
lifeApplication: Before resentment takes another turn, step back from the story and return to the peace you are being asked to keep.

source.shortMeaning: Release becomes possible when return matters more than replay.
source.lifeApplication: When the old sentence rises again, release it before it claims the room.

evidence.coreClaim: Release becomes possible when return matters more than replay.
evidence.turn: Remember this: received forgiveness becomes lasting peace when it ripens into Naam.
